WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT
    orderslink,
    AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_total_rebate,
    AVG(rebrate / NULLIF(feerate, 0)) AS avg_rebate_fee_ratio
  FROM fees
  WHERE rebrate >= 0.0005
  GROUP BY orderslink
),
with_mean AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    AVG(avg_rebate_fee_ratio) OVER () AS overall_mean_ratio
  FROM per_order
)
SELECT
  orderslink,
  avg_total_rebate,
  avg_rebate_fee_ratio,
  avg_rebate_fee_ratio / NULLIF(overall_mean_ratio, 0) AS relative_ratio
FROM with_mean
WHERE overall_mean_ratio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY relative_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: “Clear the 0.0005 threshold” means rebrate >= 0.0005. Missing rates and zero fee rates yield no ratio; AVG ignores those missing ratios. The mean is across per-order averages, with each order weighted equally.
